name: Question:  Marked Price of an article is Rs. 1000. A shopkeeper gives two successive discounts on the M.P. If one discount is 10% and second discount is x%. If the selling price is Rs. 720, find the second discount.  Hindi: किसी वस्तु का अंकित मूल्य ₹1000 है। उस पर लगातार दो छूट दी जाती हैं। पहली छूट 10% तथा दूसरी छूट x% है। यदि विक्रय मूल्य ₹720 है, तो दूसरी छूट ज्ञात कीजिए।
description:
TRICK:

MP = 1000

1st Discount = 10%

1000 → 900

Ab 900 se 720 ho gaya.

Discount = 900 - 720
         = 180

Second Discount % = (180/900) × 100
                   = 20%

Answer = 20%

Shortcut Trick:

1000 × (100-10)% = 900

Ab dekho:
900 → 720

Jo kam hua = 180

x% = (180/900) × 100
   = 20%

Yaad Rakhne Ki Line:

"Pehli chhoot hatao,
Nayi price pao,
Nayi price se jo ghata,
Wahi doosri discount bata."
